stories.title: Leading the Way
stories.detail: 26 pts has Kade Macdonald sitting pretty, pure Lions three-peat energy at the top of the card.

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - 1 off the pace with 4 to play

stories.title: The Bolter
stories.detail: 9 spots in one hit for Quinton Chamberlain, the leaderboard reshuffled like a round 24 ladder.

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Lovely to have Michael Leary from Wagga City GC out on the course with us today.

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 2 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: The Impossibility
stories.detail: Zero wipes from 13 holes - is this card even theirs?

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 twos on the bounce on holes 18, 1 & 2

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: On Cruise Control
stories.detail: A run of 7 straight scoring holes - smooth sailing

stories.title: Brief Interruption
stories.detail: Back-to-back wipes on holes 4 & 5 - we'll pretend this didn't happen

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 14, 15 & 16 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: The Bounce Back
stories.detail: Wipe then a 3-pointer on holes 14 & 15

stories.title: Not Today, Scoreboard
stories.detail: 4 wipes from 11 holes - the scorecard is mostly fresh air

stories.title: Rough Patch
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 16 & 17 - club still in the bag

stories.title: One-Point Parade
stories.detail: 3 in a row on holes 14, 15 & 16 - sticking to the 1-point script

stories.title: Not Done Yet
stories.detail: Wipe on hole 14, 3-pointer on hole 15 - that's better

stories.title: Short Memory
stories.detail: 2 wipes, every one followed by a score - forgets fast

stories.title: Wipe Artist
stories.detail: 5 wipes in 9 holes - technically a very consistent performance

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 11, 12 & 13 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: The Golf Tax
stories.detail: One good hole then one bad on holes 12 & 13 - the course charges a fee for everything

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 10 & 11 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: 3rd to 11th for Vicky Richards, one of those weeks where the bunker rules against you twice.
